import sys, random, time
from array import array
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/submission")
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("submain", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def brute(items, full, npairs):
    n=len(items); size=1<<n
    unions = array('I', bytes(4*size)); costs = array('H', bytes(2*size))
    best=None; bm=0
    for mk in range(size):
        if mk:
            low=mk&-mk; i=low.bit_length()-1; prev=mk^low
            u=unions[prev]|items[i][0]; unions[mk]=u
            c=costs[prev]+items[i][1]; costs[mk]=c
        else: u=0;c=0
        if u==full:
            key=(c,mk.bit_count())
            if best is None or key<best: best=key; bm=mk
    return best

def check(items, npairs, label):
    full = (1<<npairs)-1
    t0=time.time()
    sol = m._solve_cover(items, full, npairs)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    b = brute(items, full, npairs)
    assert sol is not None, label
    assert (sol[0], sol[1]) == b, (label, sol, b)
    # verify the chosen set really covers
    cov = 0
    for q in sol[2]:
        for it in items:
            if it[2]==q: cov |= it[0]
    assert cov == full, (label, sol)
    return dt

random.seed(7)
worst = 0
# random item sets
for trial in range(300):
    npairs = random.randint(1, 28)
    n = random.randint(1, 20)
    items = []
    for i in range(n):
        mask = random.getrandbits(npairs)
        if mask == 0: mask = 1 << random.randrange(npairs)
        items.append((mask, random.randint(1,1000), "q%02d"%i))
    # ensure full coverable
    cov = 0
    for it in items: cov |= it[0]
    if cov != (1<<npairs)-1: continue
    dt = check(items, npairs, "rand %d"%trial)
    worst = max(worst, dt)
print("random item sets OK, worst %.3fs" % worst)

# pathological: 20 singleton masks over 20 elements
items = [(1<<i, 1000-i, "q%02d"%i) for i in range(20)]
dt = check(items, 20, "singletons")
print("singletons OK %.3fs" % dt)

# pathological: 20 items each covering a random half
items = [(random.getrandbits(20) | 1<<i, random.randint(1,1000), "q%02d"%i) for i in range(20)]
dt = check(items, 20, "halves")
print("halves OK %.3fs" % dt)

# classic hard set cover instance (from literature)
items = [
 (0b00000000000000000000000011111111,  6, "a"),
 (0b00000000000011111111111100000000, 6, "b"),
 (0b00001111111100000000000011111111, 6, "c"),
 (0b11110000000011111111110000000000, 6, "d"),
 (0b00000011111111110000000011111111, 6, "e"),
 (0b11111111110000000000111111111111, 6, "f"),
 (0b00000000000011111111111100000000, 6, "g"),
 (0b11111111111100000000000000000000, 6, "h"),
]
dt = check(items, 28, "literature")
print("literature OK %.3fs" % dt)
